title: Plynth plan, version 2
description: Everything marked on a floor plan, as written by Plynth before version 3. Plynth still reads these files and upgrades them: every floor gets an empty items list. All lengths are in metres. x points right and y points down, as in the plan image, with the image's top left corner at (0, 0). Ids are unique across the whole file and never change. Plynth writes every field; other tools may leave out the fields that are not required, which then take the default shown. The left and right side of a wall are as seen on the plan looking from its from point toward its to point; right is the direction (-dy, dx), where (dx, dy) runs from the from point to the to point. Version 1 files (plan.v1.schema.json) are upgraded when read: openings get hinge start and swing right. Curved walls and rounded corners are true circular arcs; readers that need straight segments cut an arc of radius r and sweep a (radians) into the smallest count n of equal angle segments with a / n at most 7.5 degrees and r * (1 - cos(a / (2n))) at most 0.005 m, with n from 2 to 256.

name.description: A catalog or registry name such as a material, room type, asset or opening shape.

pixels_per_metre.description: Plan image pixels per metre. null until the scale is set.

name.description: Shown on the floor tab. Defaults to the id.

image.description: Plan image path relative to the project folder, with forward slashes, for example plans/floor1.png. null when the floor has no image.

corner_radius.description: Rounds the corner with an arc touching the centre lines of both walls. Only used when the point joins exactly two straight walls meeting at an angle between 1 and 179 degrees. The arc meets each wall r / tan(angle / 2) from the point; the radius is made smaller when needed so that distance is at most half of each wall's length. 0 is a sharp corner.

from.description: A point on the same floor.

to.description: Another point on the same floor.

height.description: Overrides the floor's ceiling height, for half walls. null uses the ceiling height.

bulge.description: Bends the wall into a circular arc through both points: signed distance from the middle of the straight line to the middle of the arc. Positive bends toward the right side. 0 is straight, and a size below 0.001 counts as straight. Plynth keeps it at most half the straight length either way (a half circle). Lengths and offsets along a curved wall are measured along the arc.

type.description: A room type id, for example living, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, hall, dining, office, storage or other. The list is user editable, so readers accept any well formed name. null until the user picks a type.

walls.description: Walls on the same floor that bound the room: the outer ring in order, then the ring of each island inside it.

wall.description: A wall on the same floor.

offset.description: Distance along the wall (along the arc for a curved wall) from its from point to the centre of the opening.

shape.description: An opening shape id. Built in: rectangle, round_arch, flat_arch, pointed_arch, circle. Other ids are custom shapes from the user's Library/shapes folder (shape.schema.json); a reader without that shape should report it rather than refuse the file.

width.description: Measured along the wall, the same way as offset.

sill.description: Height of the bottom of the opening above the floor.

hinge.description: The jamb a door hangs on: start is the one nearer the wall's from point, end the one nearer its to point. Kept for every type; only doors use it.

swing.description: The side of the wall a door opens toward. Kept for every type; only doors use it.

frame.description: A catalog asset fitted to the opening. null for none.
